libtv.origin: Read-only extraction of /usr/local/bin/libtv from the locally imported onecreation reference image
libtv.distribution: Provide the verified binary with --artifacts-dir; upload to a private artifact repository for CI. No credentials are included.

kling.origin: npm registry; exact version and integrity in build/kling/package-lock.json

chrome.origin: Read-only extraction of /opt/google/chrome from the locally imported cloud reference container; browser distribution only, no user profiles
chrome.distribution: Provide --with-chrome --with-browser --artifacts-dir; stage chrome.tar from a private artifact repository.

modelPolicy: Model weights and VAD files are external, read-only versioned artifacts. No automatic downloads or model substitution.
